title: Moonfall
summary: The nights ran out. Impact, and nothing after it.

epilogue.title: The Crater
epilogue.text: A crater where the Hollow was, wide as the sky, and the moon gone from it. There is a silence in the dust, and no one left to break it.

epilogue.title: The Vagrant
epilogue.text: The Ghostlight Express runs on past the edge of the crater, its lamp swinging, and the Vagrant keeps his hat on this time.
